events_exchange_date_check.name: events_exchange_date_check
events_exchange_date_check.value: strftime('%Y-%m-%d', "events"."exchange_date") is not null and strftime('%Y-%m-%d', "events"."exchange_date") = "events"."exchange_date"

gift_reservations_timestamps_check.name: gift_reservations_timestamps_check
gift_reservations_timestamps_check.value: ("gift_reservations"."status" = 'reserved' and "gift_reservations"."released_at" is null and "gift_reservations"."purchased_at" is null) or ("gift_reservations"."status" = 'released' and "gift_reservations"."released_at" is not null and "gift_reservations"."purchased_at" is null) or ("gift_reservations"."status" = 'purchased' and "gift_reservations"."released_at" is null and "gift_reservations"."purchased_at" is not null)
